hypothesis: Separating <=1024px tone analysis from 2048/4096px integer partition geometry, while retaining complete native ink height >=16px, improves long-word spatial detail without a photograph underlay. Negative plates may still prevent commercial aesthetic promotion.
analysis: Fractional rectangles evaluated by bilinear extension of summed-area arrays: exact area integration of the piecewise-constant analysis pixels, not a per-pixel source rendering.
geometry: Uniform positive scale, zero rotation/mirroring, complete templates inside disjoint integer cells, all output pixels partitioned, native ink height >=16px. Native glyph size does not certify physical print readability.

timing.scope: partition + stencil preparation + complete paint + synchronous full RGBA readback; excludes template generation, PNG encoding, UI and audit

stoppingRule: After R2 archive actual images and failures; no third tuning of this hypothesis. Promote only after commercial aesthetic, native readability and delivery contracts, never from numeric pass alone.
